riders: While you are holding Martial Focus and not wearing heavy armor, you gain the following benefits:
standing from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement;
squeezing does not impose Disadvantage on your Drunken Style attack rolls;

TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_EMPTY_CUP_STANCE.note: HUNT111 / MMX113: the parser read the two negated benefits as the benefits themselves and typed 'squeezing does not impose Disadvantage on your Drunken Style attack rolls' as disadvantage on your Drunken Style attack rolls, and 'creatures Off-Rhythm from you do not gain Advantage on attacks against you from you being Prone unless they are within 5 feet of you' as that advantage, inverting a defensive stance into a self-inflicted debuff. Both negations stay printed rules: the table has no 'remove this penalty' effect kind (combat/attack_modes.py has no DISADVANTAGE token), so removing them is a lock-round item and the lines stay riders. 'standing from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement' is also NOT automated: the stance is a passive, and the compiler skips passive rows (factory_compiler.py, skipped['passive']), so the movement effect below is a typed record of the printed benefit, not something the engine runs. Its sentence therefore stays a rider so the GM still reads it to the player; only a future standing-from-Prone execution could drop it, and that is not this correction's job. The activation trigger is supplied here so the eligibility gate (Martial Focus, no heavy armor) survives the correction: a review otherwise replaces the whole model-v2 activation and leaves the trigger null.
